newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end stable, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end stable, seen consolidating.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed stable on Thursday amid an absence of liquidity-upsetting factors, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended 5.235 percent against Wednesday's 5.243 close, with 30-day commercial paper staying flat at 5.20-5.25 percent.
Dealers expected the rates to hover around the current levels in the next week.
The bond market was quiet in the afternoon session. The seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 5.8950 against 5.8775 after morning trade.
